A front-on flat illustration of one wide closed hotel room door, the door frame touching all four edges of the canvas, on a fully transparent background. The door is wide, its proportions exactly the canvas ratio of two wide by three tall. Line art only, in hot pink #ff5a9e ink with one consistent thick line weight, nothing filled in, everything between the lines fully transparent. Shows: door frame with moulded architrave, one large upper recessed panel and one large lower recessed panel, each with one inner moulding line, two simple hinges on the left edge. No door knob, no handle, no keyhole. Strictly symmetric and orthographic, no perspective, no floor, no text, no numbers. Flat screen-print look: only flat solid inks, hot pink #ff5a9e, deep aubergine #3a1238, blush #ffe3ee. No gradients, no 3D, no bevels, no glow, no soft shadows.
